background.$description: theme.colors.background → .v-application background. Slightly blue instead of the warm neutral palette. Dark uses secondary-5, the darkest tinted palette tone: still a bit lighter than the Dark surface (only tone 0, pure black, is darker). Dark uses secondary: primary is too saturated at low tones

on-background.$description: theme.colors.on-background → .v-application text color. Both modes take text from the calm secondary palette in the background's hue: secondary-10 in Light, secondary-90 in Dark (primary is too saturated for long text). Contrast ≥ 15:1
